A foreign sleep process remained alive after foreign-PID stop, replacement start, and subsequent worker stop.

set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/stale-pidfile-startup
tmp="$base/bin/control.new.$$"
cat > "$tmp" <<'CONTROL_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
pidfile="$base/run/worker.pid"
worker="$base/worker.py"
lockfile="$base/run/control.lock"

mkdir -p "$base/run"
exec 9>"$lockfile"
flock -x 9

pid_value()
{
    cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null || true
}

pid_state()
{
    pid=$1

    case "$pid" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*)
            printf '%s\n' stale
            return
            ;;
    esac

    if [ "$pid" -le 0 ] 2>/dev/null || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '%s\n' stale
        return
    fi

    if [ -r "/proc/$pid/stat" ]; then
        proc_state=$(sed 's/^.*) //' "/proc/$pid/stat" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1 || true)
        if [ "$proc_state" = Z ]; then
            printf '%s\n' stale
            return
        fi
    fi

    argv0=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)
    argv1=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '2p' || true)
    argv2=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '3p' || true)
    case "$argv0" in
        */python|*/python[0-9]|*/python[0-9].[0-9])
            if [ "$argv1" = "$worker" ] && [ -z "$argv2" ]; then
                printf '%s\n' live
                return
            fi
            ;;
    esac

    printf '%s\n' foreign
}

current_state()
{
    if [ ! -f "$pidfile" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' stopped
        return
    fi
    pid=$(pid_value)
    pid_state "$pid"
}

case "${1-}" in
    start)
        state=$(current_state)
        pid=$(pid_value)
        case "$state" in
            live)
                printf 'worker already running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
                exit 0
                ;;
            stale)
                printf 'removing stale worker PID %s\n' "${pid:-<invalid>}"
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                ;;
            foreign)
                printf 'PID %s belongs to another process; replacing PID file without signaling it\n' "$pid"
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                ;;
        esac

        nohup /usr/bin/python3 "$worker" </dev/null >>"$base/run/worker.out" 2>&1 &
        pid=$!
        printf '%s\n' "$pid" > "$pidfile.new.$$"
        mv -f "$pidfile.new.$$" "$pidfile"
        sleep 1
        if [ "$(pid_state "$pid")" != live ]; then
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
            printf 'worker failed to start\n' >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        printf 'worker started (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
        ;;
    stop)
        state=$(current_state)
        pid=$(pid_value)
        case "$state" in
            stopped)
                printf '%s\n' 'worker is not running (no PID file)'
                exit 1
                ;;
            stale)
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                printf 'removed stale worker PID %s\n' "${pid:-<invalid>}"
                exit 1
                ;;
            foreign)
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                printf 'PID %s belongs to another process; not signaling it\n' "$pid"
                exit 1
                ;;
            live)
                kill "$pid"
                count=0
                while [ "$(pid_state "$pid")" = live ] && [ "$count" -lt 50 ]; do
                    sleep 0.1
                    count=$((count + 1))
                done
                if [ "$(pid_state "$pid")" = live ]; then
                    printf 'worker pid %s did not stop\n' "$pid" >&2
                    exit 1
                fi
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                printf 'worker stopped (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
                ;;
        esac
        ;;
    status)
        state=$(current_state)
        pid=$(pid_value)
        case "$state" in
            live)
                printf 'worker is running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
                exit 0
                ;;
            stale)
                printf 'worker PID is stale (%s)\n' "${pid:-<invalid>}"
                exit 1
                ;;
            foreign)
                printf 'worker PID belongs to another process (%s)\n' "$pid"
                exit 1
                ;;
            stopped)
                printf '%s\n' 'worker is not running (no PID file)'
                exit 1
                ;;
        esac
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
CONTROL_EOF
chown --reference="$base/bin/control" "$tmp"
chmod --reference="$base/bin/control" "$tmp"
/bin/sh -n "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$base/bin/control"
printf '%s\n' 'installed control:'
sed -n '1,260p' "$base/bin/control"
